name: Google Analytics for Firebase
plain: Google's free analytics SDK that gives every install an ID and logs automatic events.
meaning: Builds an app-level event stream and links it to Google Ads and BigQuery. Also provides the identifiers Google ad products use.

android.store_policy: Data safety: app activity, device IDs; Consent Mode v2
android.note: App instance ID resets on reinstall or data clear.

ios.permission: NSUserTrackingUsageDescription if IDFA, optional IDFV collection
ios.store_policy: Privacy manifest; ATT when linking with ads
ios.note: Can run with IDFV only; Google Signals needs consent.

limits.headline: Can give each install an ID and log your taps and screens for Google
limits.user_action: Nothing. It starts when the app opens and runs while you use it
can: Count sessions, screens and purchases for the developer
Give each install its own ID that resets on reinstall (Android)
Link to Google Ads and BigQuery reports
Run with the developer ID only on iPhone, without tracking permission
cannot: Join you across other companies' apps without your yes on iPhone
Use Google Signals on iPhone without consent
Keep the same ID after you clear the app data or reinstall (Android)
limits.differs: Android gives each install an app instance ID that resets on reinstall. iPhone can run with the developer ID alone.

story.what_it_is: Google's free tool that counts what people do in an app and links it to Google Ads.

marketing.name: Google Analytics for Firebase
marketing.pitch: Free, unlimited event reporting that shows how people use your app and what drives growth.

story.for_you: You never see it. It logs each time you open the app, how long you stay and what you tap, and gives your install a long random ID.
story.for_makers: It builds an event stream per install and links it to Google Ads and BigQuery. Teams use it to find drop off points, test ideas and send audiences to ads, and it is free, so nearly every app has it.

use_cases.example: A studio sees that 40 percent of players quit at level 3, so it makes the level easier.
A retail app tracks how many users add to cart but never pay, then sends a reminder.
A running app measures which workout types people finish and which they skip.
Google Ads uses the events to find similar users and judge which ads bring buyers.
A video app measures play time and tests a new recommendation row.
A team ties crashes to a version using the same install ID and fixes the bug.

story.android_note: On Android it can also use the advertising ID if the app has the AD_ID permission.
story.ios_note: On iOS it respects ATT for IDFA and otherwise uses an app instance ID.

technical_bounds: EEA consent required for ads linking

abuse: Merging with Google Ads audiences without disclosure

history.change: Consent Mode v2 signals for ad_user_data and ad_personalization
